package.protected_original_build_project_user_st: All four saved hashes verified unchanged
package.runtime_qualification: Full Release suite on host architecture; universal binary metadata/signature checked. Physical Intel, macOS14/26 and live Photoshop/Photato qualification remain open.

api.adobe: Five partial/three unimplemented endpoint groups unchanged. Automatic /v1/auto-crop and manual crop actionJSON remain unsupported; no Adobe route invented.

limitations: Maximum16MP source/output canvas,64MP total materialized raster pixels and4MP content-aware-fill output. Larger requests fail explicitly.
Exact Photoshop resampling, synthesized pixels, crop-background context and default preferences remain unqualified.
Crop frame rotates over the original image; complete Photoshop auto-centered image-under-frame interactions, Classic Mode, crop shield preferences and overlay variants remain open.
W×H×Resolution/resampling mode, custom presets, physical units, perspective crop, Ruler workflow, Trim and automatic multi-photo crop/straighten remain open.
Delete Cropped Pixels applies to ordinary raster image storage. Smart Object sources, editable vectors/text and mask storage are retained; precise Photoshop storage behavior remains unqualified.
New fill patches contain only exposed gaps outside the original canvas; interior transparency remains. Existing off-canvas pixels exposed by a retained crop are reused.
Adobe auto-crop is automatic subject/object detection and has not been implemented by this manual crop increment. Manual crop actionJSON is also unsupported.
Full live, physical Intel and macOS14/26 qualification remain open.
